purpose: Cursor 光标; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandCursor](../../lib/src/components/cursor.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Flutter MouseTracker selects local software cursor sessions. Forced priority yields to explicitly nested cursor scopes; native child cursors win in scoped mode. Pointer actions remain child-owned.
interface.events: Cursor observes mouse events only; child hit testing, gestures, focus, selection and keyboard remain intact.
interface.composition: A forced region precedes native descendant cursor annotations but defers to explicitly nested IslandCursor scopes. Scoped mode follows Flutter child cursor contracts without inspecting widget types.
interface.accessibility: Cursor artwork and its complete overlay entry are decorative: no semantic node, focus target or pointer blocker. Underlying interactive child semantics remain available, including after mouse hover.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Owned sessions/positions are local; detach lets Flutter activate the next native cursor. No custom engine or third-party plugin required. Software-pointer latency needs platform profiling.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.
